qa_pairs.question: What is the BMW part number for replacing the trunk floor plate on a convertible E30?
qa_pairs.answer: The part number is 41 12 585 for replacing the trunk floor plate (partial replacement behind cross member) with tail panel removed on convertibles.

qa_pairs.question: What page should you refer to for additional information before beginning this trunk floor plate replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: You should refer to information on page 41-001 before starting the repair.

qa_pairs.question: What components should be removed or covered up in the repair area?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove or cover up all car parts which are located in the repair area or subjected to heat, sparks and dust.

qa_pairs.question: What is the first step shown in the procedure for accessing the trunk floor area?
qa_pairs.answer: The first step is to drill out spot welds on the left and right sides of the trunk floor area.

qa_pairs.question: What must you do to the connections on both sides before proceeding?
qa_pairs.answer: You must uncover connections on left and right sides before proceeding with the repair.

qa_pairs.question: Where should the cutting line be marked on the cross member?
qa_pairs.answer: Mark the cutting line behind flange of the cross member, with the cutting line approximately along edge of bead.

qa_pairs.question: What important caution is given when cutting off the trunk floor plate?
qa_pairs.answer: Important! Don't damage the side members when cutting off the trunk floor plate along the marked line.

qa_pairs.question: Where should you cut off the trunk floor plate in relation to the wheel house?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut off trunk floor plate at wheel house on left and right sides.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to spot welds on the left and right sides during the repair?
qa_pairs.answer: Uncover and drill out spot welds on left and right sides.

qa_pairs.question: How far toward the rear should spot welds be drilled along the side members?
qa_pairs.answer: Drill out spot welds along side members approximately 80 mm (3.150") toward rear.

qa_pairs.question: What diagram number shows the step for marking the cutting line behind the cross member flange?
qa_pairs.answer: Diagram 30 41 623 shows the step for marking the cutting line behind flange of the cross member.

qa_pairs.question: What diagram number illustrates the final step of drilling out spot welds along the side members?
qa_pairs.answer: Diagram 30 41 626 illustrates drilling out spot welds along side members approximately 80 mm toward the rear.
